newsitem.title: ROMANIA: BUCHAREST BOURSE TO GAIN ONE MORE STOCK.
newsitem.headline: BUCHAREST BOURSE TO GAIN ONE MORE STOCK.

text.p: One more company is expected to join the Bucharest bourse this week bringing to 23 the total traded stocks, the exchange said on Tuesday.
It said food packaging company AMEP SA, which won listing last December, would join second-tier trading on Wednesday.
AMEP, a state-run company based in the northeastern town of Tecuci, has a capital of 12.88 billion lei in 12.88 million shares with a face value of 1,000 lei each.
The State Ownership Fund holds 51 percent of AMEP, in which its staff hold a 20 percent stake and other stockholders have 29 percent.
A bourse statement said the company planned investments worth 1.35 billion lei in upgrading this year and the next.
The Bucharest stock exchange, opened in November 1995, now trades 22 stocks, of which only two on the first tier. ($=7,744 lei)
